public_rationale: The conditional forecast cannot yet be scored because its financing-exhaustion condition is unverified. Earlier funding does not prove continued access, and selective lending retrenchment does not establish that the sector's money has run out. The forecast remains open without a deadline.
limitations: This disposition does not reject the proposed mechanism.
The claim supplies no quantitative trigger or time allowed for the consequences.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI bubble will burst when the money runs out.

statement.excerpt: What I can tell you is that the bubble bursts when the money runs out.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that a broad loss of financing for the AI investment boom leads to its collapse.
A collapse means a broad, sustained reversal in investment and valuations accompanied by canceled projects or business failures.
Higher financing costs, individual failed deals and temporary stock declines do not alone establish that financing has run out.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes broad financing exhaustion followed by a sustained collapse of the AI investment boom.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a verified financing cutoff, durable operating cash generation or replacement funding sustains the boom through the affected funding cycle.
